name: Restreamer
description: Restreamer is an open-source streaming server developed by datarhei, designed to simplify live video broadcasting. It provides an intuitive web-based interface that allows users to set up and manage streams without requiring advanced technical knowledge. Supporting a variety of streaming protocols, including RTMP, HLS, SRT, and WebRTC, it enables seamless video transmission across different platforms.
short_desc: An easy to use open source video server
author: datarhei
